title: Product Owner – SAP PP/PM
description:
Descrição da vaga
A AB InBev está conduzindo um dos maiores projetos de transformação digital com SAP no mundo: o Projeto Aurora.
Essa iniciativa global envolve a migração para o SAP S/4HANA, modernizando processos e sistemas em escala inédita, conectando equipes de diferentes países e impactando diretamente a forma como operamos e inovamos.
Se você deseja fazer parte dessa jornada e atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, global e desafiador, essa oportunidade é para você
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner para atuar nos módulos SAP PP (Production Planning) e SAP PM (Plant Maintenance). Esse profissional será responsável por impulsionar a transformação tecnológica corporativa, garantindo que as soluções estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio e às políticas globais da companhia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Suporte a novas implementações SAP S/4.
Dados: validação de carga de dados e atividades de cutover.
Testes: apoiar testes, acompanhar execuções e gerenciar atividades junto aos times locais.
Cutover & Hypercare: executar atividades locais, gerenciar checklists e apoiar o processo de cutover e hypercare.
Change Management: mapear e tratar impactos e mudanças na operação.
Treinamento: elaborar materiais e capacitar Key Users para implementação.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior completa.
Experiência em SAP no módulo PP ou PM;
Experiência em gerenciar projetos SAP;
Mandatório Inglês fluente.
Disponibilidade para viagens internacionais frequentes.
Conhecimento que esperamos:
Capacidade de influenciar decisões estratégicas e defender a excelência técnica.
Autonomia para experimentar, aprender com erros e buscar constantemente novos conhecimentos.
Abertura para diferentes pontos de vista e formas de pensar.
Habilidade de comunicação com pessoas de diferentes culturas e países.

Desconto mensal em produtos AMBEV;
Wellhub (Gympass);
Fretado;
Abono anual referente a um salário.
OLÁ, SOMOS A AMBEV TECH
Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev
Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. O match perfeito entre o portfólio da maior cervejaria do mundo e soluções de Data & Analytics, Cibersegurança, Infraestrutura, Suporte, Field, Engenharia e Arquitetura de Software. Contamos com cerca de 50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.
Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.
PROTAGONIZAMOS SOLUÇÕES GLOBAIS
Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a Ambev Global Tech, hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. Com escritórios espalhados por países como Estados Unidos, México, Índia, Argentina e Brasil, estamos conectados a uma rede global de inovação e tecnologia para transformar a Ambev em uma plataforma que conecta pessoas e o ecossistema.
NOSSO JEITO TECH DE SER
Por aqui, sonhamos grande e sabemos a importância de ter equipes cada vez mais diversas. É através da pluralidade de ideias, experiências e opiniões que conseguimos pensar fora da caixa e criar soluções inovadoras. Por isso, contamos com nosso Comitê de Autenticidade Tech para olhar com muito carinho e responsabilidade todas as questões relacionadas à inclusão.
QUER TRABALHAR COM A GENTE?
Para atuar na Ambev Tech com projetos nacionais, temos unidades em Blumenau (SC), Maringá (PR), São Paulo (SP) e Jaguariúna (SP), e contamos também com um time remoto em vários cantos do Brasil e América Latina. Atuamos com os modelos de trabalho remoto, híbrido e presencial, que irão depender da especificação da vaga e de sua localidade, combinado?
Para projetos internacionais, na Ambev Global Tech, a contratação acontece no modelo presencial, em Campinas (SP).

title: Enfemeiro (a) JR - Setores Adulto /
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.
Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.
Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.
A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.
Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.
#vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with the managers, directors and technical leaders of our organization to elevate our architecture practices to the next level;
  • Collaborate and support the technical leaders in making technical decisions following our standards and guardrails/guidelines;
  • Help other teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical debts and bugs;
  • Foster adoption of best coding practices and patterns;
  • Write technical documentation (with charts, data points and diagrams) and present technical solutions to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner;
  • Help create the architecture principles and present to different stakeholders (e.g.: managers, technical leaders, directors, product managers);
  • Suggest, develop and implement new tools and technologies to solve cross-functional problems;
  • Communicate and elaborate ideas to both technical and non-technical individuals;
  • Identify possible improvements in our overall architecture, perform proof of concepts (POCs) and drive the adoption of new architectural concepts with different teams;
  • Assist in the career development of other developers by providing technical mentoring, pair programming and/or reviewing PRs;
  • Actively contribute to our Backend community by planning, executing and presenting in our Backend Guild sharing technical knowledge;
  • Facilitate communication and alignment of technical backlogs between squads.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field OR relevant time Software Engineering work experience;
  • Solid fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving;
  • Expertise in at least one programming language and its main frameworks;
  • Experience in Systems Architectural styles (Monolith, Plugin, SOA, Microservices, Event-driven);
  • Knowledge of Architecture concepts (Software design, hexagonal architecture, onion, clean architecture);
  • Experience with APIs and capabilities;
  • Experience in leading the deployment of systems into production;
  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms and main providers;
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) Technologies;
  • Experience in System Modeling (desirable experience in tactical DDD);
  • Familiarity with Monitoring Tools, Metrics, and Observability;
  • Experience with Agile Framework;
  • Understanding of DevOps culture, automation (CI/CD), and main tools;
  • Knowledge of Quality practices (stress tests, load, TDD, BDD);
  • Advanced level of english.

More about you

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We Offer

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.

title: It operations analyst
description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Human Resources Services

Reporting and Analysis:

- Prepare briefing materials and updates for the EVP and executive leadership.

Strategic Planning and Goal Management:

- Lead quarterly, semi-annual, and annual planning processes, including goal setting, KPI development, and alignment sessions with regional and functional leaders.

Operational Cadence and Communication:

Leadership Support and Scheduling:

- Oversee planning and logistics for leadership offsites, conferences, and international trips.
- Process Improvement and Operational Efficiency:

Team Alignment and Action Tracking:

Banco de Talentos – Área Comercial (EV, EC e SDR)

Estamos sempre em busca de profissionais apaixonados por vendas, relacionamento e crescimento. Mesmo que não tenhamos vagas abertas neste momento, queremos conhecer talentos que desejam construir carreira em nossa área comercial.

Principais áreas de atuação

  • Sales Development Representative (SDR): prospecção ativa, qualificação de leads e apoio ao time de vendas.
  • Executivo de Vendas (EV): condução de processos comerciais, apresentações de soluções e fechamento de novos negócios.
  • Executivo de Contas (EC): gestão de carteira, relacionamento com clientes e identificação de novas oportunidades.

O que buscamos

  • Pessoas comunicativas, com energia e vontade de aprender.
  • Experiência (ou interesse em desenvolver-se) em vendas, prospecção e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Organização, resiliência e foco em resultados.
  • Vontade de crescer junto com a empresa.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento na área comercial.
  • Contato com uma equipe de alta performance.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento e plano de carreira.

Ao se inscrever, você fará parte do nosso Banco de Talentos. Assim que surgirem vagas compatíveis com seu perfil, entraremos em contato!

description:
Vaga para TRABALHO 100% PRESENCIAL em CAMPINAS - SP.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Closer de Vendas Inbound com experiência em vendas consultivas , que saiba conduzir com maestria calls de fechamento , nutrir relacionamentos via WhatsApp e gerenciar todo o funil dentro do HubSpot .

Você vai lidar com leads que já demonstraram interesse nos nossos produtos (cursos e mentorias), com o objetivo de entender suas necessidades e apresentar a melhor solução da nossa empresa, conduzindo-os ao fechamento com excelência.

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como closer responsável por converter leads em clientes;
  • Realizar calls consultivas de vendas com leads qualificados;
  • Utilizar WhatsApp e HubSpot CRM para relacionamento, acompanhamento e fechamento;
  • Atualizar o funil de vendas e registrar todas as interações no HubSpot;
  • Manter uma agenda de follow-ups ativa e organizada;
  • Trabalhar alinhado com o time de pré-vendas (SDR) e com o time de entrega;
  • Acompanhar métricas de conversão e propor melhorias no processo de vendas;

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Closer/Vendedor(a) consultivo em vendas de High Ticket ;
  • Experiência com CRM HubSpot ou outro CRM similar (obrigatório);
  • Habilidade em fechamento via videochamadas e WhatsApp;
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e poder de persuasão;
  • Organização para manter o CRM limpo, atualizado e estruturado;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre funis de vendas, inbound marketing e follow-up estratégico;
  • Desejável: experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, cursos online ou vendas B2C/B2B de ticket alto;

Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado com vendas em lançamentos, perpétuos ou funis automatizados;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas como SPIN Selling, Receita Previsível, Copywriting para vendas;
  • Familiaridade com metas, métricas de conversão e rotina de equipe comercial;
  • Familiaridade com e-commerce ou marketplaces como Mercado Livre e Amazon;

Somos um ecossistema com diversas soluções para empresas que desejam vender os seus produtos na internet ou que já vendem e querem aumentar os seus resultados. Dentre várias soluções, nosso core business é de treinamentos e mentorias online , com mais de 25 mil empresas impactados pelos nossos serviços.

Nosso foco é capacitar pessoas e empresas a venderem produtos físicos nos principais canais de e-commerce do Brasil, como Mercado Livre e Amazon , ou até mesmo estruturar sua própria Loja Virtual, ampliando oportunidades no comércio digital.

Representada por Dhiego Rosa – Instagram : @dhiegorosa e YouTube : dhiegorosa – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.

Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre , destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina .

Diferenciais

Sobre ATACADÃO

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas , pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio.

  • Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services.
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;

  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);

  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas
description:
Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

description:
Na Amyris, somos pioneiros no uso de micróbios para transformar açúcares derivados de plantas em moléculas de alto desempenho em larga escala. Nossa plataforma abre acesso à química requintada e sofisticada encontrada em todos os sistemas vivos, levando a novas possibilidades de produtos, oportunidades de mercado e soluções de sustentabilidade. Aqui na Amyris, somos um time de pessoas criativas e inovadoras. Nós valorizamos as relações saudáveis em diferentes perspectivas e nos empenhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, abrangendo diferentes raças, etnias, gêneros, religiões, pessoas com deficiências e comunidade LGBTQIA+.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Investigar de maneira aprofundada em literatura científica mecanismos que podem vir a gerar ganhos aos processos produtivos Amyris ou que auxiliem na resolução de problemas complexos durante o desenvolvimento dos processos, na manufatura ou nos diferentes CMOs;
  • Planejar experimentos em escala piloto e de bancada necessários para o desenvolvimento de processos de fermentação das diferentes moléculas do portfolio da companhia ou para troubleshooting de campanhas de produção para que atinjam os KPIs/qualidade planejados;
  • Utilizar softwares de análise estatística para analisar os dados de cada experimento e compará-los/gerar correlações com os dados disponíveis da manufatura ou de experimentos anteriores;
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos em língua portuguesa e inglesa compilando todas as metodologias, resultados e conclusões de cada um dos experimentos executados no PD;
  • Preparar documentos de transferência de tecnologia;
  • Preparar apresentações para os diferentes fóruns de discussão de resultados, inclusive com a matriz nos Estados Unidos;
  • Realizar treinamentos e suportes de campanhas de produção de acordo com a necessidade da empresa;
  • Preparar requisições de compras para materiais necessários ao desenvolvimento de processos. Organizar transportes de amostras e preparo de documentação necessária para análises externas.
  • Acompanhamento de auditorias de segurança, biossegurança, qualidade, processos, etc (conforme determinado pelo coordenador da área);
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos da companhia, quando houver demanda/oportunidade (PTL).
  • Treinar novos pesquisadores, engenheiros de processos ou técnicos de fermentação nos processos Amyris, nos conceitos importantes de cada projeto, para cada molécula;
  • Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de planejamento de experimentos, DOEs, DCCRs, PBs para avaliação de efeitos isolados e sinergias de variáveis de processo sob os resultados dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos no PD;

  • Experiência em redação de relatórios técnicos, transferências de tecnologia e análises de dados/análises estatísticas geradas a partir dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos na planta piloto.

Client Onboarding Department

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combating financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures.
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements.
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met.
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding).
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft).
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained.
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress.
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening.
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews, projects or audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out.
  • Efficiently deal with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries.
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team.
  • Keep management timely informed of issues and developments.
  • Ensure compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company‑determined parameters are complied with.
  • Demonstrate the highest level of standards of integrity and conduct and reflect Company Values.
  • Always comply with Marex’s Code of Conduct.
  • Fully understand and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility.
  • Report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/or your supervisor as required.
  • Escalate risk events immediately.
  • Provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills And Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients.
  • Solid understanding of client categorisation.
  • Worked in support of trading desks.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

Competencies

  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self‑efficient and influences a positive work environment.
  • Demonstrates curiosity.
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast‑paced environment.
  • Ability to work within a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment.
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others.
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness.

Conduct Rules

  • Act with integrity.
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence.
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators.
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly.
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct.
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

  • Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.
  • Integrity – Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

A non‑bureaucratic, but well‑controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Os projetos de eficiência energética realizam ações em comunidades baixa renda, além de beneficiar clientes residenciais com redução da conta de energia, através do uso seguro e mais eficiente da energia elétrica. Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the job

The Product Manager for BEES Deliver will play a pivotal role in driving the product evolution and development of our logistics digital transformation solution. This role involves leading cross-functional teams to enhance product features, optimize connectivity with the BEES ecosystem, and ensure a seamless delivery experience for our global customers. The Product Manager will be responsible for structuring the core journey of BEES Deliver to become a global product and expand its reach with minimal customizations.

What you'll do:

  • Guide Product Discoveries: Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI, sales, and logistics teams to define the users’ problems to be solved and how to find optimal solutions for them, transforming this into product evolution requirements.
  • Define Requirements: Create high-level requirements to document all findings and definitions from the discovery phase.
  • Epics creation and management: Create epics and manage the Epic board, including detailing, status updates, and identifying affected countries.
  • User Stories Creation: Write and manage User Stories, ensuring they are well-defined, with adequate acceptance criteria, and aligned with the product vision.
  • Lead execution of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • User Research: Collaborate with UX Research to align research materials, scripts, and scopes to gain insights into user behavior.
  • Prototype Development: Partner with Product Design to support them in the creation of effective prototypes.
  • Architectural Planning: Work with Architects to support them in the creation of the architecture solution for new initiatives and map out dependencies.
  • Tracking Plan: Collaborate with the Data Team to establish a segment tracking plan.
  • Measure Hypothesis: Monitor product performance and customer feedback, using data-driven insights to inform decision-making.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure timely delivery of product milestones.

What you'll need:

  • Experience as a Product Manager in an e-commerce, logistics or tech environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Familiarity with software development methodologies and tools such as Mixpanel and JIRA.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment, and adapt to changing priorities.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance

description:
Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology‑led service provides access to all major exchanges, order‑flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award‑winning data, insights and analytics.

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combatting financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding)
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft)
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑Ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews/projects/audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out
  • Efficiently dealing with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team
  • Keeping management timely informed of issues/developments
  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To elevate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients
  • Solid understanding of client categorisation
  • Worked in support of trading desks
  • Analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self‑efficient and influences a positive work environment
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast‑paced environment
  • Ability to work within a fast paced and high‑volume environment
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing othersStrategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect

Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity

Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative

We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People

Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble

Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

title: Arquiteto de Engenharia de Software
description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em sistemas financeiros, gestão de crédito ou recuperação de ativos;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de dados e automação de processos complexos;
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico Bradesco;
  • Cartão Flash (VA/VR e auxílio flexível);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados anual;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass );
  • Programa de Capacitação (Auxílio educação);

Aqui, o aprendizado é constante: a cada novo ativo adquirido, você estará imerso em um processo dinâmico de identificação de problemas e criação de estratégias eficazes. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de transformar mercados, impulsionar grandes projetos e crescer profissionalmente em um ambiente enérgico e colaborativo.
